column2: By evening the tide began to ebb, leaving shells on the sand.
column3: 傍晚潮水開始退去，在沙灘上留下貝殼。
column5: ebb 諧音「欸」，潮水一退，大家欸了一聲

column2: The family embarked at dawn and watched the harbor slip away.
column3: 一家人黎明時登船，看著港口漸漸遠去。
column5: em 進入 + bark 像 barge 駁船：走進船裡

column2: Her uncle emigrated from Taiwan to Canada when he was twenty.
column3: 她的叔叔二十歲時從台灣移居加拿大。
column5: e 出去 + migrate 遷移：從自己國家移出去

column2: The city council enacted a law that bans plastic bags in markets.
column3: 市議會制定了一項法律，禁止在市場使用塑膠袋。
column5: en 使成為 + act 行動：讓法案變成有效行動

column2: Reading every day can enhance your vocabulary and your writing skills.
column3: 每天閱讀能提升你的字彙量和寫作能力。
column5: en 使 + hance 高：讓某事物變得更高更好

column2: The museum visit enlightened us about how ancient farmers lived.
column3: 參觀博物館讓我們明白了古代農夫是怎麼生活的。
column5: en 使 + light 光：讓腦袋亮起來

column2: Travel enriches our lives by showing us new foods and cultures.
column3: 旅行讓我們認識新的食物與文化，豐富了我們的生活。
column5: en 使 + rich 富有：讓變得更豐富

column2: Over centuries, the river eroded the soft rock into a deep canyon.
column3: 經過數百年，河流把軟岩侵蝕成深谷。
column5: e 外 + rode 像 rodent 齧齒動物：一點一點啃掉

column2: Over millions of years, small sea animals evolved into land creatures.
column3: 數百萬年間，小型海洋動物逐漸演變成陸地生物。
column5: e 出 + volve 轉動：慢慢轉出新模樣

column2: The magazine excerpted three pages from her new novel.
column3: 雜誌從她的新小說中摘錄了三頁。
column4: excerpt a passage (摘錄一段文字)
column5: ex 外 + cerpt 取：從書裡取出一小段

column2: The school expelled two students for bringing fireworks to class.
column3: 學校因兩名學生帶煙火到教室而將他們退學。
column5: ex 向外 + pel 推：向外推出學校

column2: The dentist extracted a loose tooth from the little girl's mouth.
column3: 牙醫從小女孩嘴裡拔出一顆鬆動的牙齒。
column5: ex 向外 + tract 拉：向外拉出來

column2: The campfire flared suddenly when Dad added a dry log.
column3: 爸爸添了一根乾柴，營火突然竄亮起來。
column4: a fire flares up (火焰竄起)
column5: flare 像 flame 加 air：火遇到空氣就亮起來

column2: Candles flickered on the table as a cool wind slipped through the window.
column3: 涼風從窗縫吹進來，桌上的蠟燭搖曳閃動。
column5: flicker 的 fl 像飄動，ker 像打火機喀一下閃光

column2: Angry at the loss, the player flung his cap across the field.
column3: 球員對輸球很生氣，把帽子甩過球場。
column5: fling 諧音「忽鈴」，一甩忽地飛出去

column2: A small butterfly fluttered above the flowers in our garden.
column3: 一隻小蝴蝶在我們花園的花朵上空振翅飛舞。
column5: flutter 想成 flat + utter：薄薄翅膀快速拍動

column2: Nobody could foresee how quickly the small shop would grow famous.
column3: 沒有人能預見這家小店會多快變得出名。
column5: fore 前面 + see 看：先看到未來

column2: He promised never to forsake his friends, even in hard times.
column3: 他承諾即使在艱難時期也絕不拋棄朋友。
column5: for 離開 + sake 緣故：不管緣故離你而去

column2: The villagers fortified their walls before the fierce winter arrived.
column3: 村民在嚴冬來臨前加固了城牆。
column5: fort 堡壘 + ify 使：把地方變成堡壘

column2: She fell off her bike and fractured her wrist in two places.
column3: 她從腳踏車上摔下來，手腕有兩處骨折。
column5: frac 打破：fraction 分數就是把整體打破成小塊

column2: The strong wind fragmented the thin ice into small floating pieces.
column3: 強風把薄冰打成漂浮的小碎片。
column5: frag 打破：fragile 易碎，fragment 碎片

column2: The sudden thunder freaked the puppy out, and it hid under the bed.
column3: 突然的雷聲把小狗嚇壞了，牠躲到床底下。
column5: freak 諧音「福利克」，嚇得整個人失常

column2: Mom fretted over every little noise while Dad was driving home.
column3: 爸爸開車回家的路上，媽媽為每個小聲響煩躁不安。
column4: fret over small things (為小事煩惱)
column5: fret 諧音「福瑞」，福瑞天天為小事操心

column2: Raindrops glistened on the leaves after the morning shower.
column3: 早晨的陣雨過後，雨滴在葉子上閃閃發亮。
column4: glisten in the sun (在陽光下閃耀)
column5: glisten 的 listen 藏在裡面：靜靜聽，雨滴閃閃發亮

column2: The students graphed the temperature changes over the whole week.
column3: 學生把整週的氣溫變化畫成圖表。
column4: graph the data (用圖表呈現資料)
column5: graph 本身就是圖，當動詞就是畫成圖

column2: In the dark room, he groped for the light switch on the wall.
column3: 在黑暗的房間裡，他摸索牆上的電燈開關。
column4: grope in the dark (在黑暗中摸索)
column5: grope 像 rope 繩子，手像摸繩子一樣一點一點找

column2: The farmer hacked at the thick weeds with a sharp tool.
column3: 農夫用一把利器猛砍濃密的雜草。
column5: hack 諧音「黑克」，手一揮黑克黑克砍下去

column2: Fans hailed the young singer as the hero of the night.
column3: 粉絲們歡呼稱讚這位年輕歌手是今晚的英雄。
column5: hail 與 hello 同發音開頭，用來向人招呼

column2: Some online users harass others by sending mean messages every day.
column3: 有些網路使用者每天傳惡意訊息來騷擾別人。
column5: harass 諧音「哈啦絲」，一直找你哈啦很煩人

column2: The boy was hospitalized for a week after the bike accident.
column3: 男孩在腳踏車意外後住院治療了一星期。
column5: hospital 醫院 + ize 使：被送進醫院

column2: The cat hunched its back when it saw the big dog.
column3: 貓看到大狗時把背拱成弓形。
column4: hunch over a desk (伏在桌前駝背)
column5: hunch 像 bunch 一團：身體縮成一團

column2: The runner hurdled the fence and kept chasing the bus.
column3: 跑者跨過圍欄，繼續追著公車跑。
column5: hurdle 諧音「憨豆」，憨豆跳過欄杆

column2: The king imprisoned his enemies in a tall tower for many years.
column3: 國王把敵人關在高塔裡許多年。
column5: im 進入 + prison 監獄：把人放進監獄

column2: The tall tree inclines toward the east because of the strong wind.
column3: 那棵高樹因強風而向東傾斜。
column5: in 往 + cline 傾斜，和 decline 是同一家族

column2: Red-crowned cranes inhabit the wetlands along the northern coast.
column3: 丹頂鶴棲息在北方海岸的濕地一帶。
column5: in 在裡面 + habit 習慣居住：住在裡面成習慣

column2: The nurse injected the medicine into my arm and smiled kindly.
column3: 護士把藥液注射進我的手臂，並親切地微笑。
column5: in 進入 + ject 丟：把藥丟進身體裡

column2: Our school plans to integrate music and math in one project.
column3: 我們學校計畫在同一個專題中結合音樂和數學。
column4: integrate A with B (把 A 與 B 結合)
column5: integr 完整：把部分合成完整的一體

column2: A stranger intruded into the garden and frightened our dog.
column3: 一個陌生人闖進花園，嚇到了我們的狗。
column5: in 進入 + trude 推擠：硬擠進別人的地方

column2: The constant buzzing of mosquitoes irritated everyone in the tent.
column3: 蚊子不停的嗡嗡聲讓帳篷裡每個人都很煩躁。
column5: irritate 諧音「愛瑞特」，蚊子叮得人愛瑞特煩

column2: The criminals kidnapped the businessman and asked his family for money.
column3: 歹徒綁架那位商人，向他的家人勒索金錢。
column5: kid 小孩 + nap 小睡：把孩子偷偷帶走
